text:
leo: Heads-up: starting v2 gradual rollout to prod-us-east in ~7m. Plan: 5% -> 15% -> 40%. Watch p95, 429s, and client-signature 4xx.

deploybot: Canary scheduled: rollout-id r-us-88, start 6429990030, initial 5%. Pause if errors > 1% OR p95 > 2x baseline OR client-signature_4xx > 0.3%.

tara: FYI we flipped the client-signature header normalization for v2 (case-preserving). Some older clients expect lowercased header names and return a signed header with case differences, which could fail verification. We saw a small repro in staging.

simon: Which tenants do we expect to be sensitive? List of older SDKs: tenant-alpha, tenant-legacy, partner-acme. Recommend watching those and preemptive pins if we see signature failures.

ops-sre: Canary started at 6429990030. Initial telemetry: p95 steady, global errors 0.1%. Watching per-tenant signature failures.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 15% at 6429990040.

ops-sre: Alert: client-signature 4xx spike for tenant-legacy at ~6429990043. Localized but above threshold for that tenant.

leo: Pause rollout. deploybot, pin tenant-legacy and partner-acme to v1. Also add a routing throttle for retries on streaming for those tenants.

deploybot: Executing commands:

```
/deploy pause r-us-88
/deploy pin tenant-legacy v1
/deploy pin partner-acme v1
/edge throttle tenant-legacy streaming_retries 3s
```
Pins and throttle applied; canary paused at 6429990046.

tara: Root cause confirmed: the signature verifier in v2 performs a strict header-name match; older SDKs send signatures computed against a lowercased header set. Patch in PR #1450 adds a compatibility mode toggled by header in request to accept case-insensitive verification.

simon: Can we do an opt-in header on the v2 edge to accept legacy signatures for pinned tenants, then resume a small canary? That would avoid a full rollback while we cut a proper hotfix.

leo: Prefer minimal blast radius. Plan: 1) apply edge toggle for legacy-accept on the canary nodes only; 2) validate 10m; 3) if stable, rollout again with extra hold at 15%. Also add a short release-notes entry about signature compatibility.

deploybot: Applied edge toggle on canary nodes at 6429990048.

ops-sre: After toggle, tenant-legacy signature failures dropped to baseline. No other tenants impacted.

release-notes-bot: Draft entry created: "v2 initial rollout: strict header-case signature verification could trigger client-signature 4xx for legacy SDKs. We applied a canary toggle to accept case-insensitive signatures and pinned affected tenants to v1 during mitigation; a hotfix is planned."

leo: Follow-ups: cut PR backport to stable branch, add integration test for header-case variations, and update operator playbook to include a signature-compat toggle step. Re-open if we see additional failures.
